summaries.n-anthropic-ipo: Coins named for Anthropic's planned stock listing. Anthropic (ANT, Pump.fun): "$ANT The Meme Stock for the Anthropic IPO". Anthropic (ANT, StonkFun): "The Anthropic Ant." Anthropic (ANTS, Pump.fun): "As Anthropic eyes Wall Street, Ant Group dons a suit." Anthropic (Anthropic, Clanker V4, Robinhood Chain) has no description; its name is the story. Posts of 2026-10-26 from Cointelegraph, The Kobeissi Letter and Wall Street Engine (e3:1) report that Anthropic filed an S-1 seeking a Nasdaq listing under the ticker ANT, and a Bloomberg post of 2026-10-29 05:28 UTC covers investors' proxy trades for the IPO. Dates from Codex: the ANT pool on StonkFun opened 2026-09-11 and the ANT pool on Pump.fun 2026-10-19, both before the filing; the ANTS token and the Robinhood Chain Anthropic pool opened on 2026-10-28, after it. The descriptions are the coins' own; none of the coins is shown to be connected to Anthropic.
summaries.n-zcash-launchpads: Solana coins built around Zcash. SNARKS Launchpad (SNARKS, Meteora DBC): "Official Snarks Launchpad coin, every trade pays a 1% fee in ZEC and 60% of it goes to holders every 48 hours." Sapling (SAPLING, Pump.fun): "the rootstock of SAPLING, the zcash launchpad on solana. 0.50% of every trade on every coin buys $SAPLING and burns it." Zcash Shielded Assets (Stamp, Pump.fun) has no description; its name is the story, and a Moonshot post of 2026-09-20 calls it verified there. BSC News (2026-10-29 05:50 UTC) says Zcash turned 10 on 2026-10-28; Snarks Pad posted "Happy birthday @Zcash $SNARKS" the same evening and sapling.cash posted on 2026-10-29 01:04 UTC that its launches now run on Raydium LaunchLab (e2:1, e3:3). Pools opened on 2026-09-20 (Stamp), 2026-09-25 (SAPLING) and 2026-10-11 (SNARKS). Fee, payout and burn claims are the projects' own and are not verified here; SAPLING was in an earlier narrative that was retired on 2026-10-03 at the cap.
